_doc: Direction B — reliability of each SBERT-9D trait vs Opus reference on the 35 held-out wills (Pearson r). Source: scripts/experiments/sbert_quality_eval_claude_ref.py + composite-axis analysis. CAVEAT: N=35 -> wide CIs; the extremes (top/bottom) are trustworthy, the middle ranking is noisy. Use this as the single source of truth for which dimensions the radar/gameplay should trust.

optimism_vs_suspicion.note: BEST signal — beats either trait alone (noise-averaging)

bold_vs_cautious.note: POISONED by risk_aversion(0.19); do NOT use as-is

recommendation.radar_action: Show tier1 prominently (or the 2-axis summary); de-emphasize tier2; HIDE tier3. Never combine risk_aversion into a composite axis.
